correctness.rationale: Gaussian integration gives the exact Z_T. Ground-state conjugation gives a confining Schrödinger operator with locally bounded potential (V′ is continuous, so there is no interface delta) and the usual one-node characterization of the gap. On each exterior half-line the weighted square-integrable solution is the recessive parabolic-cylinder branch; its origin ratio is −√2 Γ((1−ν)/2)/Γ(−ν/2), which reduces to the stated positive gamma quotient. For 0<ν<1 the recurrence in terms of the two lower, negative-order cylinder functions makes it positive throughout the outward half-line. Left and right logarithmic derivatives have opposite signs in the global coordinate. The interior cosine starts at phase arctan r_- and ends at π−arctan r_+, with exactly one interior zero. With u=√T the implicit equation is smooth near (k,u)=(π/L,0) and its k derivative tends to L>0. The tail gamma expansion contributes log 2 and the cubic arctangent subtracts (π/2)/3, giving the stated B; B>0. With k0=π/Z_T the shift is −B k0³ T^(3/2)/Z_T+O(T^(5/2)), so expanding T k² and replacing Z_T by L in the correction gives the stated O(T³) error. As a separate finite check, solved the half-interval odd-state condition for L=κ_-=κ_+=1 using a midpoint Dirichlet condition and a Tricomi U tail evaluated near the interface. The measured/predicted correction ratios at T=10⁻³,10⁻⁴,10⁻⁵,10⁻⁶ were approximately 0.684567, 0.883831, 0.961323, 0.987564. These values test sign and coefficient, not the asymptotic proof. originality.rationale: The Nov. 2 published Resultary expansion gives the same beyond-mass coefficient for the exact symmetric subcase, more strongly for every fixed mode with an unexpanded effective denominator and a sharper remainder. It also supplies the complete one-wall impedance and its cubic phase coefficient. Equal nonunit stiffness amounts to rescaling; at unequal stiffnesses the very same two single-wall phases merely add in the flat interval, as shown below. No distinct dispersive coefficient or new mechanism survives narrowing to unequal walls. This is verified prior coverage and a routine extension, not a verdict based on a missing article.
